Consulting Service and Requesting Provider

Consulting Service: Nephrology
Requesting Provider: Not provided

Reason for Consultation

Evaluation of hyperkalemia with potassium level of 6.1 mEq/L.

History of Present Illness

Patient is a 66-year-old admitted with hyperkalemia. Serum potassium was found to be elevated at 6.1 mEq/L, prompting nephrology consultation.

Past Medical History

Not provided

Medications

Spironolactone — dose not specified in dictation — recommended to hold

Allergies

Not provided

Social History

Not provided

Family History

Not provided

Review of Systems

Not documented in the dictation

Physical Examination

Not documented in today's dictation

Testing Results

Potassium: 6.1 mEq/L

Assessment

Patient is a 66-year-old with hyperkalemia (potassium 6.1 mEq/L), likely related to spironolactone use. The elevated potassium requires intervention to prevent cardiac complications. Management will focus on dietary potassium restriction and discontinuation of the offending agent, with reassessment of serum potassium in the near term.

Recommendations

1. Hold spironolactone.
2. Recommend a low-potassium diet.
3. Repeat serum potassium level in 6 hours.

We will continue to follow. Thank you for allowing us to participate in this patient care.
